ITEM 1 | Pale golden grain mixture with small granular texture, dry and fluffy, scattered across the upper right of the plate, roughly 40% of a 26 cm plate's footprint in a mound about 1.5 cm tall; sits beside a cherry tomato half on top | 120
ITEM 2 | Cherry tomatoes, bright red and glossy, halved and whole, about 1.5-2 cm across, scattered among the greens and on the grain mound | 45
ITEM 3 | Mixed salad greens with dark purple-red leaves and bright green spinach-like leaves, some crisp and some wilted, with a few shredded pale white cabbage-like strands, spread over the left portion of the plate in a mound about 3 cm tall | 60
ITEM 4 | Crumbled white cheese pieces, opaque and matte, small 0.5-1 cm chunks scattered over the salad greens | 10
ITEM 5 | Cooked green beans, bright green with slight browning on some pods, trimmed ends, each about 6-8 cm long and 0.5 cm thick, arranged in a loose pile at the lower left of the salad | 70
ITEM 6 | Sliced meat, brown-grey exterior with darker seared edges, pinkish-brown interior, moist with slight juice sheen, cut into thick slices about 1 cm thick, fanned across the right of the plate in a piece roughly 9 cm by 5 cm | 110
ITEM 7 | Two rectangular flatbread pieces, golden-tan crust with browned blistered spots, topped with melted pale yellow cheese and red tomato sauce in patches, each piece about 7 cm by 4 cm and 1 cm thick, lying at the bottom right of the plate | 140
ITEM 8 | Light vinaigrette or dressing residue, faint sheen on the greens and plate surface, thin layer, barely visible | 5
